questions.question: The capital account and the current account differ in that:
options: Capital holds the long-term stake and hardly moves; the current account receives profit shares and surrenders drawings every year
Capital is updated monthly; the current account is frozen
The current account holds the mortgage bond

questions.question: A DEBIT balance on a partner's current account announces that:
options: The partner has taken out more than was earned — the partner owes the business

questions.question: Partners' salaries and interest on capital are:
options: Operating expenses deducted before gross profit
APPROPRIATIONS — slices of a profit already earned, below the net profit line

questions.question: The partnership agreement sets out:
options: Only the trading hours of the shop
The credit terms granted to customers
Salaries for labour, interest for waiting capital, any bonus, and the ratio for the remainder

subtopics.title: Dividing the Profit — the Appropriation Account

questions.question: After salaries R192 000, interest R40 000 and the bonus R8 000, the remainder of the R300 000 profit is:
options: R60 000, shared 3 : 2 as R36 000 and R24 000

questions.question: The proof that the division is correct is that:
options: Lerato's R168 000 plus Karabo's R132 000 equals exactly the R300 000 profit — the account EMPTIES
The bank balance equals the profit

questions.question: Interest on capital at 10% gives:
options: R16 000 to Lerato and R24 000 to Karabo
Lerato R24 000 on R240 000 and Karabo R16 000 on R160 000

questions.question: Karabo's current account — opening debit 9 000, share 132 000, drawings 105 000 — closes at:
options: R18 000 credit — she cleared last year's overdraw and the business now owes her

subtopics.title: The Statements, the Notes and the Asset That Left

questions.question: The disposal's four steps, in order, are:
options: Cost out to Disposal; accumulated depreciation out to Disposal; record the proceeds; the difference is profit or loss
Proceeds first, then depreciation, then cost
Only the carrying value is moved

questions.question: Equipment costing R90 000 with accumulated depreciation R60 000, sold for R36 000, produces:
options: A profit of R6 000 — proceeds 36 000 against carrying value 30 000

questions.question: The statement of financial position totals:
options: R660 000 — assets 420 000 plus 240 000, financed by equity 448 000, loan 112 000 and current liabilities 100 000

questions.question: The capital and current account notes exist so that:
options: SARS can verify the VAT return
Each partner can audit their own treatment — every salary, interest, bonus, share and drawing in their own column

questions.question: Debtors collection of two months against thirty-day terms means:
options: Money is idling in customers' pockets — collection is slack and needs tightening
The credit terms are too harsh

questions.question: The gearing reading of 0,25 : 1 says:
options: The business is drowning in debt
Lightly geared — one rand of loan for every four of equity; headroom to borrow for expansion
Interest can no longer be paid

questions.question: The honest footnote on the roughly 71% return on average equity is:
options: Partners' salaries sit INSIDE it — it pays for their labour as well as their capital
It cannot be compared with anything

questions.question: Matching indicators to the eye that watches them:
options: The partner asks liquidity; the creditor asks return
Every eye watches only net profit
The creditor asks liquidity, the lender asks gearing, the partner asks return

subtopics.title: Two Friends, One Till, and the Paper That Keeps the Peace

questions.question: The two dangerous sentences every partnership quarrel comes from are:
options: "I invested more, so more belongs to me" and "I work harder, so more belongs to me"
"Rent is too high" and "prices are too low"
"The till is short" and "the bank is slow"

questions.question: The agreement answers both sentences with:
options: A salary for the hours worked, interest for the money that waits, and a ratio for whatever is left — written and signed

questions.question: The pile that moves every year is:
options: The BREATHING pile — the current account, receiving the profit share and surrendering the drawings

questions.question: The scoops empty the pot in the order:
options: Pay for the hours; thanks to the waiting money; the promised bonus; the agreed split of the rest
The split first, then the salaries

questions.question: "The pot is empty, to the rand" matters because:
options: Appropriation never makes or loses a cent — it only shares; bowls totalling the pot prove the division
The pot must always show a loss

questions.question: The "two rooms" a question always checks are:
options: The shop floor and the storeroom
Expenses above the profit line; sharing below it — partner salaries live in the second room

questions.question: "The friends are quietly financing their customers" refers to:
options: Debtors taking two months to settle against thirty-day terms
Stock turning eight times a year

questions.question: The creditor sleeps well because:
options: Near money covers near debt at 2,4 to one — and 1,2 to one even with the stock untouched

questions.question: Stock turning eight times a year means:
options: The shelves clear and refill about every month and a half — stock alive, never a museum

questions.question: The scoreboard way of reading any number is:
options: Round it off and move on
Trust it when it looks big
Never alone — against last year, against the terms, against the bank — then judge
